meta.title: Recruitment support | Iter Advisors
meta.description: Organise recruitment from defining the role to onboarding. Agree the scope, method and responsibilities with your team.

recrutement-talent-acquisition.h1: Recruitment support for SMEs and startups
intro: You want to hire a finance professional or strengthen your teams. The first step is to define the role, budget, skills and your organisation's ability to onboard the person.
We agree the support with you: defining the role, sourcing candidates, preparing interviews or following up onboarding. Decision-making responsibilities remain explicit.

whatIs.heading: What the engagement can cover
paragraphs: Organise recruitment from defining the role to onboarding.
Deliverables and the allocation of responsibilities are set out in the proposal.
bullets: A job description and agreed selection criteria
An interview process with roles, stages and candidate feedback
A record of applications and upcoming decisions
An onboarding framework with follow-up meetings

benefits.label: Explicit priorities
benefits.description: Define the issues to address and decisions to prepare with the relevant people.

benefits.label: Clear roles
benefits.description: Coordinate the work of the business leader, managers and providers within the agreed scope.

phases.description: Agree the need, proposed remuneration, criteria and decision-makers.
Choose suitable channels and screening arrangements. Timing depends, among other things, on the profile and market.
Structure interviews and compare applications against the agreed criteria.
Prepare initial objectives, contacts and follow-up meetings with the manager.

cases.title: Hiring a first finance lead
cases.description: Clarify the role across accounting, reporting and financial management, then organise selection with the business leader.

cases.title: Preparing several hires
cases.description: Prioritise roles, allocate interviews and check onboarding capacity before accelerating sourcing.

pricing.heading: Budget and scope
pricing.note: The quotation specifies deliverables, schedule, budget, duration, notice period and adjustment arrangements. Specialist services and any expenses are identified separately.

faq.question: How long does recruitment take?
faq.answer: It depends on the profile, market, decision-makers' availability and selected process. The schedule and follow-up meetings are agreed when scoping the engagement; no recruitment deadline is guaranteed.

faq.question: How are fees calculated?
faq.answer: The quotation specifies deliverables, schedule, budget, duration, notice period and adjustment arrangements. Specialist services and any expenses are identified separately.

faq.question: Who chooses the candidate?
faq.answer: The company retains its hiring decision. The engagement prepares comparison information and facilitates discussion with the people involved.

cta.body: Describe your organisation, existing contacts and priorities. The first discussion will help clarify the next steps.

meta.title: Payroll coordination | Iter Advisors
meta.description: Clarify who collects, produces, checks and approves payroll. Agree the scope, method and responsibilities with your team.

gestion-paie-charges-sociales.h1: Payroll management: organise roles and checks
intro: Payroll relies on reliable information flows between employees, managers, personnel administration, the payroll provider and the finance team.

The HR engagement can organise this coordination and follow-up checks. Producing payslips and filings requires an explicit scope with the relevant provider; it is not automatically included in an HR director engagement.

whatIs.heading: What the engagement can cover
paragraphs: Clarify who collects, produces, checks and approves payroll.
Deliverables and the allocation of responsibilities are set out in the proposal.
bullets: A schedule for collecting and approving payroll inputs
An allocation of responsibilities with the provider
A procedure for starters, leavers and changes in circumstances

benefits.label: Explicit priorities
benefits.description: Define the issues to address and decisions to prepare with the relevant people.

benefits.label: Clear roles
benefits.description: Coordinate the work of the business leader, managers and providers within the agreed scope.

phases.description: Identify tools, providers, shared data and the people authorised to access it.
Agree approvals, required documents and dates with the relevant people.
Document transfers and the handling of questions without creating unnecessary copies of personal data.
Review anomalies and their resolution, then adapt practices with the provider and team.

cases.title: Payroll involving several contacts
cases.description: Clarify responsibilities and the schedule to avoid conflicting requests or implicit approvals.

cases.title: Changing software or providers
cases.description: Prepare data, migration checks and handover within the agreed scope.

pricing.heading: Budget and scope
pricing.note: The quotation specifies deliverables, schedule, budget, duration, notice period and adjustment arrangements. Specialist services and any expenses are identified separately.

faq.question: Is payroll production included?
faq.answer: It must be explicitly specified in the proposal, including the provider, countries and responsibilities. HR supervision and payslip production are distinct roles.

faq.question: Which tools do you use?
faq.answer: Scoping starts with your organisation and existing software. The choice of tool depends on needs, country and the level of delegation.

faq.question: How are the budget and commitment agreed?
faq.answer: The quotation specifies deliverables, schedule, budget, duration, notice period and adjustment arrangements. Specialist services and any expenses are identified separately.

meta.title: HR training and development | Iter Advisors
meta.description: Connect skills needs to the team's work. Agree the scope, method and responsibilities with your team.

intro: A development plan starts with work situations: which skills are missing, for which tasks and with which expected effects?
Iter can help structure these needs, coordinate actions and follow up with managers. Specialist training, providers and their terms are identified separately.

whatIs.heading: What the engagement can cover
paragraphs: Connect skills needs to the team's work.
Deliverables and the allocation of responsibilities are set out in the proposal.
bullets: A summary of skills needs by team
An action plan with owners and a schedule
Follow-up meetings to review how learning is applied

benefits.label: Explicit priorities
benefits.description: Define the issues to address and decisions to prepare with the relevant people.

benefits.label: Clear roles
benefits.description: Coordinate the work of the business leader, managers and providers within the agreed scope.

phases.description: Discuss tasks, difficulties and the expectations of employees and managers.
Compare training, on-the-job support, internal knowledge transfer and organisational changes.
Define participants, arrangements and required providers while accounting for business activity.
Review what is put into practice and the adjustments needed with the team.

cases.title: Supporting new managers
cases.description: Identify situations in which they need guidance and organise suitable support.

cases.title: Preparing changes in tools
cases.description: Connect learning needs to the tasks that actually change and plan follow-up after adoption.

pricing.heading: Budget and scope
pricing.note: The quotation specifies deliverables, schedule, budget, duration, notice period and adjustment arrangements. Specialist services and any expenses are identified separately.

faq.question: Do you deliver all training?
faq.answer: The proposal distinguishes HR support, internal actions and training delivered by specialist organisations.

faq.question: Is funding guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Funding options and conditions must be checked with the relevant organisations for the situation and selected action.

faq.question: How can we assess the usefulness of actions?
faq.answer: Define the work situations targeted at the outset, then review with the manager whether learning is applied. Attendance at training is not enough to demonstrate a result.

meta.title: HR compliance and employment law | Iter Advisors
meta.description: Identify issues to address and involve the right professionals. Agree the scope, method and responsibilities with your team.

intro: HR management organises the monitoring of practices, documents and employee relations matters. It identifies questions requiring specialist advice and prepares useful information for their review.
Applicable law, employer responsibilities and advisers' roles must be examined in the context of your company and the country concerned. HR support does not automatically replace legal advice.

whatIs.heading: What the engagement can cover
paragraphs: Identify issues to address and involve the right professionals.
Deliverables and the allocation of responsibilities are set out in the proposal.
bullets: A review list of HR matters and documents
A list of priorities and suitable professionals
A schedule for following up agreed actions
Documentation of decisions and necessary exchanges

benefits.label: Explicit priorities
benefits.description: Define the issues to address and decisions to prepare with the relevant people.

benefits.label: Clear roles
benefits.description: Coordinate the work of the business leader, managers and providers within the agreed scope.

phases.description: Specify establishments, practices and matters concerned, as well as advisers already involved.
Collect useful documents from authorised people and identify questions requiring further review.
Prepare the necessary information and organise discussions with qualified advisers.
Allocate responsibilities, track deadlines and document agreed changes.

cases.title: Structuring an HR function
cases.description: Distinguish routine tasks, checks and matters that require specialist review.

cases.title: Supporting organisational change
cases.description: Prepare the necessary information and discussions with an adviser suited to the legal context.

pricing.heading: Budget and scope
pricing.note: The quotation specifies deliverables, schedule, budget, duration, notice period and adjustment arrangements. Specialist services and any expenses are identified separately.

faq.question: Does HR support replace a lawyer?
faq.answer: No. Matters requiring specialist legal advice are handled with a qualified professional. The proposal defines each person's role.

faq.question: Do you work across several countries?
faq.answer: Scoping identifies countries, available skills and required partners. Practices are not automatically transferred from one country to another.

faq.question: Can we define a one-off engagement?
faq.answer: The quotation specifies deliverables, schedule, budget, duration, notice period and adjustment arrangements. Specialist services and any expenses are identified separately.
